description: This file contains integration tests for the '/documents' API endpoint in the Fineract project. It tests creating, retrieving, downloading, updating, and deleting documents associated with clients, ensuring the API behaves as expected.

classes.name: DocumentTest
classes.description: Integration test class for '/documents' API, extending the base 'IntegrationTest' class, containing methods to test different CRUD operations on documents.

methods.name: retrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Tests retrieving all documents for a specific client.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Tests creating a new document for a client.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific document by its ID.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Tests downloading the file of a document and verifying its content.

methods.name: updateDocumentWithoutNewUpload
methods.description: Tests updating document metadata without uploading a new file.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Tests deleting a document and verifying subsequent failure when retrieving it.

methods.name: createDocumentBadArgs
methods.description: Tests creating a document with invalid arguments, expecting failure.
